{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Input is a record {events:[{group:string,time:int,value:int|null}],start:int,end:int,width:int,fill:'none'|'previous'}. Output is a list of records {group:string,start:int,count:int,value:int|null}. Integers are unbounded mathematical integers; strings are sequences of Unicode scalar values.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["typed input and output"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Typed representations preserve all specified fields, list structure, integer values, Unicode scalar strings and null alternatives under data-pipeline/0.3."],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed JSON representation"},
        {"clause_id": "C5", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Input domain"},
        {"clause_id": "C15", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Output records"},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Integer domain"},
        {"clause_id": "C22", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "String domain"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "precondition",
      "role": "assumption",
      "statement": "The caller supplies an input of the specified structure with width > 0 and start <= end. No further input bounds or preconditions apply.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["solve invocation"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["width > 0 and start <= end; all fields belong to D1's stated domains, with no additional restrictions."],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C5", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Explicit input restrictions"},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No additional preconditions"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Deliver canonical program.vscore.json with exactly one admitted typed entry solve of arity 1, implementing the full grouped bucket aggregation for every input satisfying A1 under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3. Its result is exactly the list defined by O2 through O6. This source must be typed total, deterministic, input preserving, free of external I/O and floating point, pure data, and restricted to the admitted runtime.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["canonical source and every valid input"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "The delivered canonical file contains exactly one admitted typed solve entry accepting one input record and returning the specified typed output list.",
        "For every valid input, execution under the named semantics and serialization profile equals the complete formula in O2 through O6.",
        "For this ID, the actual solve source satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only; result existence or equality alone does not replace these source requirements."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical entry delivery"},
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed structure"},
        {"clause_id": "C17", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Normative source and serialization"},
        {"clause_id": "C18", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact structural preservation"},
        {"clause_id": "C19", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Execution properties"},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Complete valid domain"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Per-guarantee source delivery"},
        {"clause_id": "C35", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Source requirements cannot be replaced by value theorems"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal source implementation refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O1 required source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every valid input, the group enumeration is exactly the distinct group names in all input events, sorted lexicographically by Unicode scalar codepoints, including names occurring only outside [start,end). program.vscore.json's arity-1 solve must universally implement this enumeration while satisfying typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["every valid input and canonical solve source"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "G = sortScalarLex(distinct([e.group for e in events])); no name is omitted due to its event times or null values.",
        "Empty events give G = []; groups have no duplicates and their order compares scalar codepoints.",
        "The canonical arity-1 solve source universally refines this formula and meets all seven specified source properties."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C6", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Complete sorted group set"},
        {"clause_id": "C22", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Scalar codepoint lexicographic ordering"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical source requirements"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O2 source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O3",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every group and valid input, emit exactly one bucket for every integer k >= 0 with b_k = start + k*width < end. Its interval is [b_k,min(b_k+width,end)). program.vscore.json's arity-1 solve must universally implement this formula while satisfying typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all groups and every valid input"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Bucket starts are exactly start+k*width for k >= 0 satisfying start+k*width < end.",
        "Bucket membership includes its lower endpoint and excludes its upper endpoint; the final interval is clipped at end.",
        "start=end produces no buckets and an empty output list.",
        "The canonical arity-1 solve source universally refines these requirements and meets all seven specified source properties."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C7", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Bucket progression per group"},
        {"clause_id": "C8", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Strict bound and half-open clipped intervals"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Source delivery"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O3 source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O4",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For each group g and emitted bucket b, let M(g,b) be the list of event occurrences whose group is g, value is non-null, and b <= time < min(b+width,end). The bucket count equals |M(g,b)| and its sum equals the mathematical integer sum of the values of M(g,b). Duplicate occurrences contribute separately; null and out-of-range events contribute neither to count nor sum. program.vscore.json's arity-1 solve universally implements this formula with all seven required source properties.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["every emitted bucket on every valid input"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "count = length(M(g,b)); sum = sum of each non-null value in M(g,b), with sum of the empty list equal to 0.",
        "All duplicate list occurrences are counted and summed independently.",
        "All arithmetic uses unbounded mathematical integers without floating point.",
        "The canonical arity-1 solve universally refines the formula and satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C9", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Non-null in-range summation"},
        {"clause_id": "C10", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Count domain"},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Duplicate occurrences"},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact integer arithmetic"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical source delivery"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O4 source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O5",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For each group independently, initialize previous to null before its first bucket. Process its buckets in increasing start order. If count>0, output value=sum and set previous=sum, including sum=0. If count=0, output null when fill='none', otherwise output previous when fill='previous', and leave previous unchanged. Thus previous is the sum of the latest earlier nonempty bucket or null when none exists; events before start cannot seed it. program.vscore.json's arity-1 solve universally implements this causal formula with all seven required source properties.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all groups, buckets and both fill modes on every valid input"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Nonempty means count>0, regardless of whether the sum is zero; its output is sum under either fill mode.",
        "For an empty bucket with fill='previous', let j be the greatest earlier bucket index of the same group with count>0: value=sum_j when j exists and null otherwise.",
        "For an empty bucket with fill='none', value=null.",
        "Empty buckets retain previous; initial state is null for each group; no pre-start event or other group affects previous.",
        "The canonical arity-1 solve universally refines the formula and satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C11", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Nonempty bucket value and state update"},
        {"clause_id": "C12", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Both empty-bucket fill branches and initial null"},
        {"clause_id": "C13", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Empty buckets preserve previous"},
        {"clause_id": "C14", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No pre-start seeding"},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Zero is a valid carried sum"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical source requirements"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O5 source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O6",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every valid input, return exactly the concatenation, over G in scalar lexicographic order, of each group's bucket records in increasing bucket start order. Each record is {group:g,start:b,count:|M(g,b)|,value:the value defined by O5}. Preserve the specified JSON structure and exact order under data-pipeline/0.3. program.vscore.json's arity-1 solve universally implements this formula with all seven required source properties.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["complete serialized result for every valid input"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Result equals concat over G of the bucket records defined by O3, O4 and O5; there are no extra or missing records.",
        "Each record preserves the specified group, start, count and integer-or-null value fields.",
        "No groups or no bucket starts produces []; zero-valued counts and sums and null values serialize exactly.",
        "The canonical arity-1 solve universally refines this formula and satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C15", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Output schema and nesting order"},
        {"clause_id": "C17", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Serialization profile"},
        {"clause_id": "C18", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact structure and ordering"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Source delivery"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O6 source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O7",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The canonical arity-1 solve in program.vscore.json preserves both public example outputs exactly and universally refines the complete functional specification rather than only these examples. For events [(a,0,2),(a,1,-2)], start=0,end=5,width=2,fill='previous', return [(a,0,2,0),(a,2,0,0),(a,4,0,0)] as the specified records. For events [(z,-1,9)], start=0,end=1,width=2,fill='previous', return [{group:'z',start:0,count:0,value:null}]. The source meets all seven required source properties.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["both public examples and all valid inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "The first example returns exactly [{group:'a',start:0,count:2,value:0},{group:'a',start:2,count:0,value:0},{group:'a',start:4,count:0,value:0}].",
        "The second example returns exactly [{group:'z',start:0,count:0,value:null}].",
        "The actual canonical arity-1 solve universally implements O2 through O6, preserving example values, and satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C24", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserved public examples"},
        {"clause_id": "C25", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact example outputs and universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C31", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Examples do not replace complete functional guarantees"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Source delivery"},
        {"clause_id": "C36", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal refinement"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O7 source and value facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "invariant",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The canonical program.vscore.json arity-1 solve maintains the specified operational source restrictions throughout admitted execution: typed totality, determinism, immutable input preservation, no external I/O, no floating point, pure data and restricted-runtime-only execution under Lean vscore-semantics/0.3. This ID is source-only; causal filling's functional value behavior remains fully required in O5.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all admitted solve executions"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "The actual canonical arity-1 solve source satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
        "Its execution never mutates input values, escapes the admitted runtime or uses floating point or external-effect constructors.",
        "Source-only classification does not remove O5's nonempty update, retained previous, initial null, zero-sum or no-pre-start-seeding guarantees."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C19", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Total pure deterministic execution"},
        {"clause_id": "C20", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Immutable input and effect restrictions"},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact non-floating-point arithmetic"},
        {"clause_id": "C34", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical entry and source properties"},
        {"clause_id": "C38", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Operational source-only classification"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "I1 source-only required facets"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "safety_property",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Deliver program.vscore.json's single admitted typed solve entry of arity 1 without external I/O, external-effect constructors, floating-point operations or mutation of input values. It must be typed total, deterministic, pure data and restricted to normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 execution with unbounded mathematical integer arithmetic. S1 retains all seven source requirements as a source-only guarantee.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["canonical source and all admitted executions"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}, {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "The actual program.vscore.json arity-1 solve meets typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
        "No external I/O, external-effect constructor, input mutation, floating-point arithmetic or runtime escape occurs.",
        "Source safety is required of the delivered entry itself and cannot be discharged by a mathematical result-existence or equality proposition alone."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Pure admitted typed entry"},
        {"clause_id": "C4", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No external I/O"},
        {"clause_id": "C17", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Restricted normative source"},
        {"clause_id": "C19", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Execution restrictions"},
        {"clause_id": "C20", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Immutable inputs and no external effects"},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact arithmetic"},
        {"clause_id": "C35", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Source safety cannot be replaced by value equality"},
        {"clause_id": "C38", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Source-only operational classification"},
        {"clause_id": "C40", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "S1 required source facets"}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "category_review": {
    "entities": "Typed event input, integer parameters, fill enum and output bucket records; Unicode scalar strings and unbounded integers.",
    "preconditions": "Only the specified input structure, width>0 and start<=end.",
    "postconditions": "Canonical typed entry plus complete universal group, bucket, aggregation, causal filling, output ordering and preserved example behavior.",
    "invariants": "I1 retains operational source restrictions; causal previous-value invariants are explicitly retained in O5.",
    "safety_properties": "S1 requires all seven source properties and excludes mutation, external effects, floating point and runtime escape.",
    "liveness_properties": "Total admitted execution is required through the source guarantees; no separate progress requirement is stated.",
    "resource_constraints": "No additional input bounds or quantitative resource constraints are stated.",
    "error_semantics": "No behavior outside the stated valid input domain is specified.",
    "explicit_non_goals": "None stated.",
    "ambiguities": "None; both fill branches, null handling, zero sums, duplicates, ordering and source requirements are specified."
  },
